content.short: Factorial Fi is a decentralized lending and borrowing protocol on TON, focusing on capital efficiency and yield.
content.description: Factorial Fi is a robust decentralized finance (DeFi) protocol operating on the TON blockchain, specifically designed to provide secure lending and borrowing services. It allows users to supply their digital assets to liquidity pools to earn interest or use them as collateral to borrow other tokens in a non-custodial manner. Factorial Fi emphasizes capital efficiency and transparency, providing the essential financial infrastructure for users to manage their liquidity and execute sophisticated yield strategies within the high-performance environment of the TON network.
content.meta: Lend and borrow with efficiency on Factorial Fi. Explore TON DeFi credit markets on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
